frozen_parent.limitation: Frozen parent critic predicts Act1 returns. Do not reinterpret it as an Act2 success probability; raw anchors remain in evaluation evidence.

endpoint.limitation: Critic predicts stochastic training policy; outcomes use greedy evaluation. Reached-act populations are policy dependent. Parent critic was trained for Act1, not Act2.

selected.limitation: Critic predicts stochastic training policy; outcomes use greedy evaluation. Reached-act populations are policy dependent. Parent critic was trained for Act1, not Act2.

missing_checkpoint_history: Intermediate checkpoint files are not included; periodic outcomes remain verifiable in hashed metrics. No reconstruction attempted.
limitations: One training seed; development-only simulator evidence. Reach-conditioned and common-reach populations do not isolate causal combat/deck effects. Greedy critic anchors are off-policy. No final holdout accessed.
